title: EnableJournal - InputEnableLayer
content:
Member of: InputEnableLayer Script Enables or disables the player's ability to use the journal on this layer. Syntax: Function EnableJournal(abEnable = true) native Parameters: - abEnable: If true, enables journal access. Otherwise disables it. Default: True Return Value: None. Examples: ; Enable journal myLayer.EnableJournal()
; Disable journal InputEnableLayer myLayer = InputEnableLayer.Create() myLayer.EnableJournal(false) See Also: - InputEnableLayer Script - IsJournalEnabled - InputEnableLayer
